job: Make the human-goal to bounded-agent-work to human-decision mechanism visible, without implying autonomous recursive self-improvement.
scene: One professional woman visibly selects a research question, supervises several bounded computer workspaces and reviews results with a red pencil before placing one selected result into a final tray.
mustShow: Adult professional woman as the dominant research lead
Several bounded computer workspaces running parallel code or experiment plots
Human selection of the final result
Rejected results visibly remaining outside the selected tray
mustNotShow: Robot, humanoid AI or disembodied AI brain
A machine choosing its own goal or shipping its successor
Readable text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks
Generic blank laptop and folder pipeline
Childlike tone or decorative plants dominating the scene

style.authority: LAiDIES current adult editorial illustration direction
style.palette: Dark navy ground with electric cyan, magenta, coral and warm paper accents.
style.finish: Adult hand-inked editorial comic detail, screenprint texture, credible research props and integrated storytelling.

output.alt: An editorial illustration of a woman setting a research goal, supervising parallel computer experiments and selecting the final result.
